name: Hotel Aqua Dome
beschreibung: The Hotel Aqua Dome (Tirol Therme Längenfeld) is an exclusive four-star superior resort located in Längenfeld within the Tyrolean Ötztal, nestled against the magnificent mountain backdrop of the Ötztal and Stubai Alps. This architecturally striking sanctuary harmonises alpine luxury with contemporary flair, offering lavish rooms and suites styled in local stone pine and ash, designer bathrooms, fireplaces, flat-screen TVs, Wi-Fi, and private balconies taking in panoramic three-thousand-metre summits. A heated bathrobe corridor connects directly to the expansive thermal spa paradise, famous for its futuristic open-air levitating basin bowls, indoor thermal pools, and the two-storey Spa 3000 with panoramic saunas. The gourmet restaurant serves multi-course culinary masterpieces highlighting regional ingredients. In winter, ski buses quickly connect to world-class Sölden and Gurgl, while summer offers boundless hiking and climbing trails.
kurzbeschreibung: Four-star superior thermal spa resort in Längenfeld in the Ötztal featuring futuristic levitating pools, vast sauna world, and fine dining.
